versions.changelog:
重构为“通用复盘核心 + Codex 数据适配器”，为后续扩展保留稳定边界
移除开源默认规则中的个人项目名、行业词和固定个人画像
项目归并改用自定义规则、工作目录、消息路径、产物目录和活动时间等证据
同一个产物只归属一个项目，证据不足时使用中性分类
活跃时长按会话片段估算，跨周长会话的 Token 改为统计时间范围内增量
增加辅助线程与系统测试任务过滤、敏感字段脱敏和可恢复异常诊断
报告内容改为动态生成，减少重复 Prompt、固定结论和无效说明
优化桌面与移动端布局，390px 宽度下无横向溢出
新增脱敏示例报告、效果截图、项目归并说明、排错文档和无依赖回归测试

Initial release of codex-review: generate clear, copy-friendly HTML usage reports for recent Codex activity.

- Scans recent Codex sessions, project files, skills, automation tasks, and token logs for the past 7 days.
- Groups data by main project and analyzes inefficiencies, prompt quality, and habits.
- Generates a well-structured, mobile-friendly HTML report with foldable sections and copyable prompt templates.
- Provides actionable weekly summaries, consumption statistics, and suggestions for workflow improvement.
- Supports automated weekly review scheduling if no similar task exists.
- Protects privacy by avoiding detailed chat logs, storing reports locally, and summarizing output concisely for end users.
